full_prompt_en: A square, simplified painted portrait shows an older bald person seated among tall grasses, seen in left-facing profile. The head is placed high near the middle of the frame, with a long nose, strong cheek plane, and downturned mouth described by a few warm ocher shadows. The gaze lifts slightly toward the left. A bright yellow coat wraps the shoulders and upper body, its high collar folding into a broad triangular shape beneath the chin. Deep mustard and orange shadows cut through the coat's large flat planes, while a small dark blue opening appears inside the collar. The forearms rest low across the lap and extend out of the lower crop. Slender blue-green stems and pale yellow seed heads rise around and behind the figure, many bending diagonally in the same breeze. The grass fills nearly the entire background, but a light cream sky remains visible between the stems in the upper left. Long, scratchlike brushstrokes give the vegetation lively movement, contrasting with the person's still, compact pose. The face is smoothly and economically modeled; the coat is more graphic, with bold angular folds. Sunlight from the upper left makes the scalp and upper coat glow and catches the tips of the grasses, while cool blue-green shadows collect lower in the field. The palette is deliberately narrow: vivid golden yellow against subdued turquoise, sage, and cream. An off-center vertical figure, surrounding fine diagonals, and generous pale gaps make the composition quiet but wind-swept.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、形体简化的绘画肖像呈现一位年长光头人物坐在高草间，从朝左侧面看见。头部置于画面中部偏上，长鼻、突出的面颊平面和微微下弯的嘴由几处暖赭阴影描述。目光略向左上。鲜黄外套裹住肩和上身，高领在下巴下折成宽阔三角形。深芥黄与橘色阴影切过外套的大平面，领内露出小块深蓝开口。前臂低低搁在腿上，并伸出下部裁切。纤细蓝绿草茎和浅黄穗子从人物周围及背后升起，许多顺同一阵风斜弯。草几乎填满整个背景，左上茎间仍可见浅奶油色天空。细长刮痕般笔触给植被活跃运动，与人物静止紧凑的姿态对照。面部平顺、节省笔画地塑形；外套更平面，以大胆棱角褶线组成。来自左上的日光让头顶与外套上部发亮，并接住草尖，下方田野积聚冷蓝绿阴影。配色有意收窄：鲜明金黄对照低饱和青绿、鼠尾草绿与奶油色。偏侧竖向人物、周围细斜线和宽裕浅色缝隙令构图安静却有风吹感。
style_prompt_en: A simplified painterly illustration sets one large saturated golden-yellow mass amid a field of fine blue-green and straw-colored diagonal strokes. The focal silhouette is economical and calm, modeled by only a few ocher planes; its larger surrounding color areas are cut into angular folds. Long scratchy lines, small seedlike flecks, and pale open gaps make the background active without detailed depth. Warm sunlight brightens upper edges and scattered tips, while cooler teal shadows settle below. Edges alternate between clear graphic boundaries on the main form and loose, wind-swept marks around it. Matte, lightly brushed color keeps the surface tactile. The composition balances a compact upright weight against many slender repeated diagonals, creating a quiet mood with a gentle sense of movement.
style_prompt_zh: 简化的绘画插画把一大块饱和金黄色放在纤细蓝绿与稻草色斜线的田野间。焦点剪影节省笔画而平静，只靠少数赭色平面塑形；周围较大色域被棱角褶面切开。长刮痕线、小穗点和浅色开放缝隙使背景活跃，却无繁琐纵深。暖日光提亮上缘和零散尖端，较冷青绿阴影沉在下方。边缘在主体清楚的平面界线与外围松散风吹笔痕之间交替。哑光、轻刷的颜色保留触感。构图以紧凑竖向重量对照许多纤细重复斜线，形成安静而轻微流动的情绪。
theme_en: An older bald person in a yellow coat amid tall grass
theme_zh: 身穿黄衣坐在高草间的年长光头人物
name: Alex Katz
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
